rv.q: Andy Fickman's production has the feel of a school show staged in a red brick assembly hall.

Christina Bennington is terrifically energetic as protagonist Veronica, skilfully navigating a clumsily written part that positions her as both the show's sardonic narrator and its conflicted emotional heart.
But it’s also, I’m afraid, plain bad.
With this brilliant new company, Heathers is well worth another look.
This Heathers cast really has made the musical their own, elevating this teenage tragedy into a razor-sharp show.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this cult film adaptation, finding it a poppy, polished production that awkwardly softens the movie's dark satire into a more wholesome, inoffensive teen musical with catchy songs.
